visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman stands centrally against a solid, vibrant red studio background. She is wearing an elaborate red strapless traditional Chinese wedding gown, which is heavily adorned with gold floral embroidery and shimmering sequins. Her hair is styled in a complex updo, decorated with multiple gold hairpins, butterfly ornaments, and long red tassels. She holds a circular red fan featuring a white phoenix and floral patterns. (2) A person's arm wearing a silver wristwatch enters the frame from the right side to adjust the woman's fan and posture. The woman remains still with a poised, neutral expression while looking slightly off-camera. The studio lighting is bright and even, casting soft shadows and highlighting the metallic sheen of her gold accessories. (3) The shot transitions to a close-up focusing on the woman's face and upper torso. She holds the red fan delicately near her chin, tilting her head slightly while looking into the camera with a soft, confident smile. Her makeup is bold, featuring dark eyeliner and deep red lipstick that complements the overall color theme of the scene. (4) A montage sequence follows, showing the woman in various elegant poses. In one shot, she holds the fan against her chest, and in another, she stands slightly turned to the side, showcasing the profile of her ornate headpiece. The background remains a consistent, high-saturation red throughout these transitions. (5) The final phase shows a medium-full shot of the woman standing gracefully. She holds the fan with both hands in front of her waist. A thin, translucent gold shawl is draped over her arms, adding a layer of texture to her ensemble as she maintains a dignified and serene presence before the video ends.
